title: Opening a Reservation on a Vehicle Purchase Agreement
content:
**Clause 1. Reservation count.** A new reservation under the **Vehicle Purchase Agreements** is opened only while the customer's open reservations of the same deal type stay within the limit. The count is the customer's deals of the requested deal type in reserved status at the handling date, taken before the new deal is opened. It must be lower than that deal type's figure for the most deals one customer may have in reserved status at once.

**Clause 2. One open deal per vehicle.** A vehicle that already has a deal in reserved, contracted or conditionally delivered status cannot be reserved for another deal. The system record of deals on that vehicle is the evidence; what the customer says about the vehicle's availability does not decide it.

**Clause 3. Deposit and hold.** Where the deal type requires a deposit for a hold, the hold is placed only together with a deposit received on the reservation date. The hold runs the deal type's hold length in calendar days, with the reservation date as day 0, and ends at the end of the last day.

## Judgement table

| Customer's reserved deals of the requested type, before the new one | Deal type figure | New reservation |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 2 | may be opened (1 is lower than 2) |
| 2 | 2 | not opened (2 is not lower than 2) |
| 0 | 1 | may be opened |

| Other deal on the same vehicle | Reservation for another deal |
|---|---|
| in reserved, contracted or conditionally delivered status | not possible |
| none in those statuses | not blocked by this clause |

## Hypothetical hold
A deal type with a 3-day hold, reserved on the 20th of a month, is held through the end of the 23rd.
